General_Description.Text: Lymphatic vessel remodeling and invasion in pancreatic cancer progression (2019). Evidence category: application. This card preserves the evidence layer's structured statements and their original field labels; it does not add a new literature review or certify benchmark scoring thresholds.
Text_Reference: Evidence-layer structured paraphrase; not a verbatim quotation. Source release: https://github.com/404NotFound422/TOCAgentProject/tree/5e3a711befb3952a2e39f4d53fc9c9f1a7ac0d22/KnowledgeBase/evidence_expansion_20261019

Application.Text1:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U001
kind: sample
sample: Human pancreas
stage: normal versus surgical PDAC
claim: Three normal cadaveric donors; three male PDAC patients 77/T1N0,52/T2N0,67/T3N0. These are distinct cohorts, not six cancer specimens.
source_locator: Methods 2.1

Application.Text2:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U002
kind: sample_preparation
sample: Human pancreatic sections
stage: fixed ex vivo
claim: 4% formaldehyde fixation 2 days, saline wash 4 days at 4 C; vibratome thickness350 um; preservation0.1% PFA at4 C.
source_locator: Methods 2.1
parameters: 
  fixation_days: 2
  wash_days: 4
  section_um: 350

Application.Text3:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U003
kind: sample
sample: Mouse pancreatic sections
stage: control/early lesion/advanced lesion/tumor
claim: B6, EK, EKP and labeled-tumor cohorts are separate. Methods representative-image counts do not replace figure-specific denominators. No viral labeling generation or animal-model induction operations are extracted.
source_locator: Methods 2.2; Figs3-7

Application.Text4:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U004
kind: sample_preparation
sample: Mouse pancreatic sections
stage: fixed ex vivo
claim: Postfixation4% PFA40min15 C, then vibratome sections and0.1% PFA4 C preservation. Main Methods does not explicitly provide mouse section thickness here.
source_locator: Methods 2.2 paragraph3
unknown: 
  [1] mouse section thickness

Application.Text5:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U005
kind: processing
sample: Fixed human and mouse pancreas
stage: permeabilization
claim: 2% Triton X-1002h15 C before labeling.
source_locator: Methods2.3 paragraph1

Application.Text6:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U006
kind: processing
sample: Fixed human and mouse pancreas
stage: blocking/primary antibody
claim: Blocking buffer2% Triton X-100,10% normal goat serum,0.02% sodium azide in PBS. Primary1:100 in0.25% Triton,1% serum,0.02% azide,1day15 C. Blocking duration unreported.
source_locator: Methods2.3 paragraph1
unknown: 
  [1] blocking duration

Application.Text7:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U007
kind: labeling
sample: Species-specific pancreas
stage: primary antibody branches
claim: Eight main-text markers must remain species and target bound; Lyve1 alone does not uniquely identify lymphatic endothelium.
source_locator: Methods2.3 paragraph1;Supp S2
marker_rows: 
  [1]     species: human
    target: podoplanin/D2-40
    catalog: 916602 BioLegend
    interpretation: lymphatic endothelium
  [2]     species: human
    target: PGP9.5
    catalog: 2932-1 Epitomics
    interpretation: neuroendocrine
  [3]     species: human
    target: glucagon
    catalog: 2810-1 Epitomics
    interpretation: islets
  [4]     species: human
    target: alpha-SMA
    catalog: ab5694 Abcam
    interpretation: stellate cells
  [5]     species: mouse
    target: Lyve1
    catalog: ab14917 Abcam
    interpretation: lymphatic endothelium and macrophage subset
  [6]     species: mouse
    target: substance P
    catalog: MAB356 Millipore
    interpretation: sensory nerves
  [7]     species: mouse
    target: Ki-67
    catalog: ab15580 Abcam
    interpretation: proliferation
  [8]     species: mouse
    target: nestin
    catalog: MAB353 Millipore
    interpretation: stemness-associated marker, not functional stem-cell proof

Application.Text8:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U008
kind: labeling
sample: Fixed human/mouse pancreas
stage: secondary/nuclear
claim: AF647 goat anti-rabbit with AF546 goat anti-mouse or anti-rat1:200. Nuclear PI or SYTO16 at room temperature1h. Secondary duration unreported.
source_locator: Methods2.3 paragraph2
unknown: 
  [1] secondary incubation duration

Application.Text9:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U009
kind: clearing
sample: Labeled fixed pancreas
stage: RI matching before confocal
claim: RapiClear1.52 used after labeling; clearing duration/temperature not stated. Product number1.52 must not be treated as measured specimen RI or clearing success score.
source_locator: Methods2.3 paragraph2
unknown: 
  [1] clearing duration
  [2] clearing temperature
  [3] measured tissue RI

Application.Text10:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U010
kind: fluorescence
sample: Matched labeled sections
stage: confocal
claim: AF647 excitation633/emission650-710nm; PI/AF546 excitation543/emission560-615nm; SYTO16/lectin-AF488 excitation488/emission500-550nm. These overlapping channel alternatives are not all simultaneous distinguishable labels. Figure colors are pseudocolors.
source_locator: Methods2.4

Application.Text11:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U011
kind: imaging
sample: Cleared pancreatic sections
stage: acquisition
claim: LSM510Meta orLSM800,10x Fluar/25x LD Plan-Apochromat(WD570um),tile scan,stitching,multi-track. Objective working distance is not experimentally proven penetration depth.
source_locator: Methods2.4

Application.Text12:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U012
kind: processing
sample: Already confocally imaged specimens
stage: subsequent histology
claim: Saline removal of clearing reagent then H&E when necessary confirms PanIN; does not establish universal compatibility for all labels.
source_locator: Methods2.4;Fig1c

Application.Text13:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U013
kind: analysis
sample: Pancreatic middle sections
stage: segmentation
claim: Lymphatic density=Lyve1 vessel voxels/ROI voxels x100%; macrophage density=cell count/ROI volume, not vessel volume fraction. Perilobular ROI within500um outside lobule edges excludes intralobular signals; perilesional parenchyma within500um of lesion.
source_locator: Methods2.5

Application.Text14:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U014
kind: statistics
sample: Figure-bound comparisons
stage: analysis
claim: Mean +/-SD or individual points; unpaired Student t-test,P<.05. Sampling locations nested in mice are not independent animal counts.
source_locator: Methods2.6;Fig6d

Application.Text15:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U015
kind: observation
sample: Normal human pancreas
stage: Fig1a-b
claim: D2-40 network contacts endocrine/exocrine structures and adipocytes;PGP9.5 shows neurolymphatic association;Fig1b projection350um.
source_locator: Results3.1;Fig1a-b

Application.Text16:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U016
kind: observation
sample: Human surgical PDAC sections
stage: Fig1c-d/S1
claim: High-grade lesion in67yearT3N0 tumor bulk; low-grade distal lesion5cm away.52yearT2N0 supplement corroborates D2-40/stroma/PanIN association;3 surgical biopsies. Cross-sectional association does not reconstruct temporal progression.
source_locator: Results3.1;Fig1c-d;SuppS1

Application.Text17:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U017
kind: observation
sample: Normal B6 pancreas
stage: Fig2
claim: Periarterial/perilobular lymphatic network, lymph-node sinus lining and bridges; contacts acini,islets,ducts,blood vessels. Intracapsular bridge morphology is not demonstrated functional valve action.
source_locator: Results3.2;Fig2

Application.Text18:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U018
kind: specificity
sample: B6 pancreas
stage: S2/S4
claim: S2 pairedF4/80(catab204467) shows only a macrophage subset Lyve1+. S4 Prox1(AF2727) plusLyve1 supports lymphatic endothelial identification in EK lesions. Supplement marker additions cannot be silently folded into the eight-marker main list.
source_locator: SuppS2,S4
additional_markers: 
  [1]     target: F4/80
    catalog: ab204467
  [2]     target: Prox1
    catalog: AF2727

Application.Text19:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U019
kind: quantitative_result
sample: Early-stage EK pancreatic lesions
stage: Fig3h-i
claim: Compared with normal parenchyma, Lyve1+ macrophage density +61% perilesional(P<.05),+263% lesion(P<.01); lymphatic density+218% in influenced area(P<.05). Fig3 n=4mice,meanSD. These are increases, not final relative percentages.
source_locator: Results3.3;Fig3h-i
results: 
  [1]     metric: macrophage_density
    region: perilesional
    increase_percent: 61
    p: <.05
  [2]     metric: macrophage_density
    region: lesion
    increase_percent: 263
    p: <.01
  [3]     metric: lymphatic_density
    region: lesion plus perilesional
    increase_percent: 218
    p: <.05

Application.Text20:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U020
kind: observation
sample: Early EK lesions
stage: S3
claim: PanIN1,lesion-islet complex,epithelial overgrowth,Lyve1+ macrophages and rich vascularity coexist; image co-occurrence does not prove macrophages caused lymphangiogenesis.
source_locator: SuppS3;Fig3

Application.Text21:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U021
kind: quantitative_result
sample: Advanced EK/EKP pancreas
stage: Fig4h
claim: Perilobular lymphatic vessel density5.5foldEK and4.9foldEKP relative normalB6(P<.01),n5;EKvsEKP nonsignificant. Treated/regrownB6vsnormalB6 nonsignificant. Fold-of-control is not plus550/490percent.
source_locator: Results3.4;Fig4h

Application.Text22:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U022
kind: quantitative_result
sample: Advanced EK/EKP pancreas
stage: Fig4i
claim: Pie charts show luminal invasion14%EK versus71%EKP,n7 per group; Results explicitly5/7EKP. Caption wording57% increase corresponds to57 percentage points on rounded chart, not57% relative increase. Two comparable sections~50mm3 per animal in4h-i.
source_locator: Fig4i actual image gr4b.jpg;Results3.4
source_issue: caption percent-increase wording ambiguous; preserve raw and interpreted metric separately

Application.Text23:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U023
kind: observation
sample: Advanced EK/EKP pancreas
stage: Fig4/S5/S6
claim: Perilobular lymphangiogenesis,endothelial invagination,luminal clusters and pancreatic-intestinal boundary network integration. Wild-type regeneration maps S5 lack comparable gross remodeling. Nestin+ luminal clusters S6 indicate marker expression, not proven tumor lineage/stem-cell function.
source_locator: Fig4;SuppS5,S6

Application.Text24:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U024
kind: observation
sample: Advanced EK/EKP pancreas
stage: Fig5/S7
claim: Approximately5um luminal bridge/valve-like tubules,proliferative Ki67+ microenvironment. S7 projections150um and450um are panel-specific; cannot assign450um to all human or mouse specimens. Functional roles are hypotheses.
source_locator: Results3.5;Fig5;SuppS7

Application.Text25:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U025
kind: quantitative_result
sample: Advanced EK/EKP pancreas
stage: Fig6d
claim: Arteriolar diameter+91%EK,+98%EKP;periarteriolar lymphatic major axis+59%EK,+72%EKP,allP<.001. NormalB6 fourmice24locations;each other group fivemice30locations. This is diameter/major axis, not vessel area or volume.
source_locator: Results3.6;Fig6d
groups: 
  normal_B6: 
    mice: 4
    locations: 24
  other_each: 
    mice: 5
    locations: 30

Application.Text26:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U026
kind: observation
sample: Fixed pancreatic tumor-model sections
stage: Fig7/S8
claim: EGFP+tumor cell clusters and some cells>500um from tumor are withinLyve1-lined lumina. Sixof six show localized lymphangiogenesis,fiveof six invasion;controln4. Extracted observation only; viral labeling and model construction operations excluded.
source_locator: Results3.7;Fig7;SuppS8

Application.Text27:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U027
kind: observation
sample: Fixed tumor necrosis boundary
stage: Fig7b-e
claim: Lymphangiogenesis also occurs intratumorally near necrosis. Five luminal states: labeled tumor cells; labeled plus host cells;host cells;nuclear fragments;empty lumen. Cell identity inference is limited by labels.
source_locator: Fig7b-e

Application.Text28:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U028
kind: imaging
sample: EGFP-labeled tumor sections
stage: S8
claim: Ten serial panels with2.5um increment show budding/invasion at tumor-lymphatic boundary; these are10depthplanes,not10animals or10replicates.
source_locator: SuppS8

Application.Text29:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U029
kind: limitation
sample: All fixed cleared pancreas
stage: interpretation
claim: D2-40/Lyve1 morphology does not establish functional lymph drainage; unphysiological clearing prevents in-vivo functional inference. Human cross-sectional specimens and mouse models cannot fully recapitulate human progression.
source_locator: Discussion paragraph4

Application.Text30:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U030
kind: hypothesis
sample: Advanced lesion lymphatics
stage: interpretation
claim: Proposed tubule roles(valves,migration passages,mechanical support,preparation for network expansion) and active metastatic role are author hypotheses,not measured functional outcomes.
source_locator: Discussion paragraphs2-3

Application.Text31:
units:
unit_id: APP233_U031
kind: video_observation
sample: fixed human/mouse pancreatic sections
stage: V1-V4
claim: V1 lesion lymphatic network with depth sweep;V2 perinodal network;V3 paired stereo tubular bridges;V4 necrosis-boundary depth sweep and separate rotating invasion reconstruction. Videos do not establish live lymphatic flow.
source_locator: mmc1-4.mp4;private_sources/video_samples.json

Application.Text32:
findings:
S2 B6 F4/80 versus S4 EK Prox1 sample bindings confirmed.

Application.Text33:
findings:
Both Lyve1 and Ki67 listed rabbit; paired source observation preserved but discrimination details not stated by examined panel.

Application.Text34:
findings:
Primary omission negative control explicitly stated.

Application.Text35:
findings:
Fig3h lesion/perilesional bracket two stars with caption P<.01 n4 mice.

Application.Text36:
findings:
Macrophage numerator cells denominator ROI voxels, not supplied calibrated physical-volume density.
